name: Advanced Tactical Academy: Signals and Shadows

lessons.title: Signals and Shadows
lessons.text: Use your Men Shen's active probe against an opponent equipped with stealth and ECM.

lessons.title: Movement plan
lessons.text: Scout with the Men Shen; keep the supporting Hunchback close enough to exploit a target.

lessons.title: Fire plan
lessons.text: Compare to-hit previews against the Anubis at different ranges. ECM and stealth are not a blanket immunity to fire.

lessons.title: Review the tradeoffs
lessons.text: Use cover and range control rather than trusting electronics to win the battle.

lessons.title: Review
lessons.text: Review the battle record and retry to improve your practice.
